change: Exact numeric kernel-output comparisons use a dense typed-array loop; Object.is semantics remain. Paper calibration still uses two single-call timing orders. Selective longer calibration is tested but not enabled in production.

policies.method: Fresh selector instances for each policy, geometry and round. Four rotating policy orders. First complete audit includes calibration and all equality checks performed by the selector. The following 16 complete audits are timed together. Fixture/module/kernel loading and the independent JavaScript/native oracle and map comparisons are outside timers. Common kernel code and scratch memory are warmed before each group. Both audit maps and all fields except elapsed time must equal the JavaScript oracle; first-call returned arrays are rechecked after subsequent calls. Only timing decisions may be retained. No optimizer runs or saved-template seeds.

comparison.method: Fresh selector instances for each policy, geometry and round. Four rounds with rotating policy order. The reference policy, when requested, loads both selector and equality code from the named commit with an identical paper-audit source. First complete audit includes calibration and all equality checks performed by the selector. The following 16 complete audits are timed together. Fixture/module/kernel loading and the independent JavaScript/native oracle and map comparisons are outside timers. Common kernel code and scratch memory are warmed before each group. Both audit maps and all fields except elapsed time must equal the JavaScript oracle; first-call returned arrays are rechecked after subsequent calls. Only timing decisions may be retained. No optimizer runs or saved-template seeds.
